blocks.title: 实体表单电子化（二期：三版块团队）

items.title: 表单生成（表单匠）
items.description: 上传图片 / PDF / Excel / Word 表单，按标记合同识别字段类型与固定命名，还原为可运行的表单应用：列表页管数据记录（新增/修改/删除/筛选），表单页带保存/提交审核/打印/导出的数据生命周期。

items.title: 电子签名（电子签师）
items.description: 按表单能力参数注入签名组件：点击签名框弹窗身份验证（演示账号）、canvas 手写录入、笔迹缩放回填、未生效可清空重签、审核通过后锁定不可改。

items.title: 操作审计（审计员）
items.description: 审计开关参数化启用（默认关闭）；开启后创建/保存/审核/打印/导出全量记录操作日志（含关键字段快照与签名摘要），仅可查看不可删除，可导出审计日志文件。

items.title: 字段规格与确认门
items.description: F# 编号三体一致（schema / 页面 / 规格文档），用户逐字段核对后批准定稿；自然语言指认修改，页面重生成后组件按能力参数重新注入。

items.title: Form generation (Form Crafter)
items.description: Upload a form as image / PDF / Excel / Word; fields are typed by the marking contract and rebuilt into a runnable form app: a list page managing records (create/edit/delete/filter) and a form page with a save/approve/print/export record lifecycle.

items.title: E-signature (Signature Smith)
items.description: Injected per form capability: click a signature box for an identity-verification dialog (demo account), handwrite on canvas, scaled stroke filled back, clear-and-resign before effect, locked on approval.

items.title: Operation audit (Auditor)
items.description: Parameterized audit toggle (off by default); once on, create/save/approve/print/export are fully logged (key-field snapshots and signature digests), view-only with no delete entry, exportable as a journal file.

items.title: Field spec & confirmation gate
items.description: F# ids align across schema, pages and spec doc; users verify field by field, then approve; pages regenerate on natural-language edits and components re-inject by capability flags.
